name: Dorothea Grief (McKeldin)
notable_stories: A German-American whose family immigrated from Bavaria
Daughter of Bavarian immigrants Michael Grief (1826–1896) and Cunigunda Vinzel (1824–1890)
sources: Maryland Manual, 1951-52, vol. 164, p. 2 (Maryland State Archives): https://msa.maryland.gov/megafile/msa/speccol/sc2900/sc2908/000001/000164/html/am164--2.html
notes: New source gives 3 Jul 1863 (prior: ~1854). Conflict retained in notes.
Prior source had birth ~1854 and death ~1925. This source gives precise: 3 Jul 1863 – 5 Mar 1925. Birth year conflict (1854 vs 1863) — preserve both, defer to records.

CORRECTION 2026-09-22: Birth changed from "abt 1854" to "3 Jul 1863" (confirmed by Brendan Adams). The later date fits the ~1877-78 marriage at ages 17 and 14 and the children's births 1880-1902; the earlier date would put Dorothea at 48 for her last child.
CORRECTION 2026-09-22: Death changed from "abt 1925" to "5 Mar 1925" (confirmed by Brendan Adams). Consistent with the earlier estimate, now exact.

Maryland Manual, 1951-52 (official state register, published while Theodore R. McKeldin was governor): Theodore "was born November 20, 1900, in Baltimore City, one of the eleven children of the late James A. and Dora (Greif) McKeldin." The same biography appears in the 1953-54 and 1955-56 editions.
